StepDescription: Launch Lorenzo Application
Login with valid credentials
Wait for home page to load
-- REGISTER NEW PATIENT --
Click on Patients tab
Wait for Patients tab to expand
Generate random surname for new patient registration
Enter generated surname in patient search field
Click Find to search for existing patient records
Wait for patient search results to load
Click Registration link to open registration form
Wait for patient registration form to load
Enter patient forename in registration form
Enter generated random surname for patient
Enter postal code to look up patient address
Click Find to resolve address from postal code
Wait for address resolution results
Select address row from postal code lookup results
Enter city in address field
Select country from dropdown
Enter home telephone number
Enter mobile telephone number
Enter email address
Click Next to proceed to additional demographics
Wait for additional demographics page to load
Select communication preference type
Select country of birth
Select nationality
Select religion
Select sexual orientation
Select ethnicity
Click Finish to complete patient registration
Wait for registration confirmation popup
Capture NHS Number from registration confirmation popup
Verify NHS Number has been successfully allocated
Click OK to close registration confirmation popup
-- FIND PATIENT RECORD AND CREATE REFERRAL --
Wait for home page to reload after registration
Click Find Record to search for the registered patient
Wait for patient basic search form to load
Enter registered patient surname to locate record
Click Find to search for registered patient
Wait for patient search results grid to load
Click patient surname link to open patient record
Wait for EPR View to load
Verify EPR View has loaded with patient PAS ID visible
Capture PAS ID from EPR View for reference
Click Referrals tab in EPR to access referral functions
Wait for Referrals tab to load
Click Create Referral context pane link
Wait for Create Referral form to load
Select referral service type
Select referral source
Select referral priority
Select referral type
Select referred to type
Click Finish Now to save referral
Wait for additional referral options popup
Dismiss additional referral options popup
-- NAVIGATE TO ACCESS PLANNING EPR VIEW --
Wait for EPR View to reload after referral creation
Click Access Planning EPR tab to navigate to access planning section
Wait for Access Planning EPR section to load
-- CREATE ACCESS PLAN ENTRY --
Click Create Access Plan Entry context pane link from Access Planning EPR View
Wait for Access Plan source selection page to load
Select Access Plan Type from dropdown
Click Next to proceed to Access Plan Details
Wait for Access Plan Details page to load
Select specialty for the access plan entry
Select treatment function for the access plan entry
Select priority for the access plan entry
Select administrative category
Select elective admission type
Select intended management for the access plan entry
Click Next to proceed to resource monitoring page
Wait for Resource Monitoring page to load
Set guaranteed activity date for the access plan entry
Select reason for override on resource monitoring page
Click Finish Now to complete access plan entry creation
Wait for Access Planning list view to reload after entry creation
Validate created access plan entry is visible in the Access Planning list view
-- MODIFY ACCESS PLAN ENTRY (1st time) --
Select the created access plan entry and click Modify Access Plan Entry from context pane
Click OK to confirm Modify Access Plan Entry action
Wait for Modify Access Plan Entry wizard to load
Click Next to proceed to Access Plan Details on Modify wizard
Wait for Access Plan Details page to load on Modify wizard
Modify elective admission type for 1st modification
Modify intended management for 1st modification
Click Finish Now to save 1st modification to access plan entry
Wait for Access Planning list view to reload after 1st modification
Validate 1st modification: Verify access plan entry is present in list view
-- MODIFY ACCESS PLAN ENTRY (2nd time) --
Select the access plan entry and click Modify Access Plan Entry from context pane (2nd time)
Click OK to confirm 2nd Modify Access Plan Entry action
Wait for Modify Access Plan Entry wizard to load (2nd time)
Click Next to proceed to Access Plan Details on 2nd Modify wizard
Wait for Access Plan Details page on 2nd Modify wizard
Modify elective admission type for 2nd modification
Modify intended management for 2nd modification
Click Finish Now to save 2nd modification to access plan entry
Wait for Access Planning list view to reload after 2nd modification
Validate 2nd modification: Verify access plan entry is present in list view
-- TRANSFER ACCESS PLAN ENTRY (1st time) --
Wait for Transfer Access Plan Entry form to load
Select transfer reason for 1st transfer of access plan entry
Select who requested the 1st transfer
Click Update to apply 1st transfer details
Wait for transfer confirmation dialog
Click Yes to confirm 1st transfer of access plan entry
Click Finish to complete 1st access plan entry transfer
Wait for Access Planning list view to reload after 1st transfer
Validate 1st transfer: Verify access plan entry is present in list view after transfer
-- TRANSFER ACCESS PLAN ENTRY (2nd time) --
Wait for Transfer Access Plan Entry form to load (2nd time)
Select transfer reason for 2nd transfer of access plan entry
Select who requested the 2nd transfer
Click Update to apply 2nd transfer details
Wait for 2nd transfer confirmation dialog
Click Yes to confirm 2nd transfer of access plan entry
Click Finish to complete 2nd access plan entry transfer
Wait for Access Planning list view to reload after 2nd transfer
Validate 2nd transfer: Verify access plan entry is present in list view
-- COPY ACCESS PLAN ENTRY --
Select the access plan entry and click Copy Access Plan Entry from context pane
Wait for Copy Access Plan Entry wizard source selection page to load
Click Next on Copy Access Plan Entry source selection page
Wait for Copy Access Plan Entry details page
Click Next to proceed through Copy Access Plan Entry details step
Wait for Copy Access Plan Entry additional details page
Click Next to proceed to resource monitoring on Copy wizard
Wait for resource monitoring page on Copy wizard
Set guaranteed activity date for copied access plan entry
Select reason for override for copied access plan entry
Click Finish Now to complete copying the access plan entry
Wait for Access Planning list view to reload after copy
Validate copy: Verify access plan entry is present in list view confirming successful copy
-- CLOSE ACCESS PLAN ENTRY --
Wait for Close Access Plan Entry form to load after selecting entry and clicking Close from context pane
Click OK to confirm Close Access Plan Entry action
Wait for Access Planning list to reload after close action
Validate close: Verify access plan entry status reflects closed state in Access Planning list view
-- MANAGE OFFER - NON ADVANCE --
Select the access plan entry and click Manage Offer (Non-Advance) from context pane
Click OK to confirm Manage Offer Non-Advance action
Wait for Non-Advance offer TCI basic search criteria page to load
Click Basic Search tab on TCI offer search page
Enter discharge date for Non-Advance offer TCI search
Select search for criteria for Non-Advance offer
Enter expected length of stay for Non-Advance offer TCI
Click Check Availability to search for available TCI slots
Wait for search results to load
Expand the first available TCI result row
Wait for TCI offer details form to load
Click Update to confirm Non-Advance TCI offer details
Click Finish to complete Non-Advance offer creation
Wait for Access Planning list to reload after Non-Advance offer creation
Validate Non-Advance offer: Verify Manage Offer context pane link exists confirming offer saved
-- MANAGE OFFER - ADVANCE --
Select the access plan entry and click Manage Offer (Advance) from context pane
Wait for Manage Offer landing page to load
Click Create New Offer to initiate a new advance offer
Click Inpatient booking type for Advance offer
Wait for Find Booking page to load
Click Basic Search tab on Find Booking page
Wait for booking search results to load
Click Next to proceed from booking search results to Ward Appointment details
Wait for Ward Appointment details page to load
Select care provider for the Ward Appointment advance offer
Select speciality for the advance offer Ward Appointment
Select treatment function for the advance offer Ward Appointment
Click Finish Now to complete Advance offer creation
Wait for Access Planning list to reload after Advance offer creation
Validate Advance offer: Verify Manage Offer context pane link exists confirming advance offer saved
-- LOGOUT --
Click Logout button to exit Lorenzo application
Confirm logout by clicking Yes on confirmation dialog
